text:
Aisha Khan: Quick company-wide note: we're deprecating automatic SDK telemetry collection (opt-out by default) and moving to explicit opt-in for all public SDKs. This affects hosted and dedicated customers and will be reflected in docs and the SDK changelogs. Please scan below for timeline and actions. :loudspeaker:

Ravi Menon: Short rationale: we heard loud customer feedback about surprise telemetry and want a consistent privacy-first default. New default: telemetry is disabled unless `telemetry: { enabled: true }` is set in client config or environment.

Camille Park: Heads-up on timeline: today — documentation + migration howto published. Next Wed (2591016000) — SDK v4.3.0-rc1 publishes with telemetry disabled by default and a deprecation warning when old env var is present. Full removal of automatic collection targeted for v5.0 in ~10 weeks.

Jordan (Eng): What counts as "telemetry"? Stack: request/response metadata (no raw outputs), SDK-level errors, perf metrics (latency, retries), and optional helper traces if users opt in. No PII, and we scrub request bodies by default.

Priya (Docs): I'll add the migration banner to relevant pages and produce a quick migration snippet. Draft snippet: 

```js
// explicit opt-in
const client = new RedwoodClient({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY, telemetry: { enabled: true, env: 'staging' } });
```

Ravi Menon: For people on older SDKs: current behaviour (auto-telemetry) will be retained for two released minor versions, but the SDK will emit a one-time deprecation log on startup. We want all active customers migrated off implicit collection before the enforcement release.

Aisha Khan: CS action: notify customers currently flagged with `telemetry_opt_in_auto=true` in the account database. Draft customer note posted here: https://intranet.redwood/announcements/telemetry-deprecation (internal). Small ask: prioritize any enterprise accounts with compliance flags.

CS-Bot: Notified 42 accounts tagged `telemetry_auto` — will create support tickets for owners.

Jordan (Eng): Ops note: runtime and logs already have a flag to drop telemetry at ingest. We'll add a header `X-Redwood-Telemetry-Opt: explicit` to requests when user opts in. Private deployments: we'll ship a config toggle to opt all requests out by default.

Camille Park: Docs checklist for teams:
- Add migration banner to SDK quickstarts
- Update the SDK config reference and show opt-in and environment variables
- Add a short FAQ about what we collect and how we scrub data

Priya (Docs): Draft banner copy: "Policy change: SDK telemetry is now opt-in by default. To continue sending telemetry, enable it explicitly in your client or set the env var. See migration guide (link)." Can we get a quick signoff?

Ravi Menon: Signoff from engineering: :+1: Please include the one-line enforcement timeline and the contact alias for escalation (security-compliance@redwood).

Aisha Khan: Release schedule: rc -> canary -> general. release-bot we'll do a staged rollout to canary regions only and monitor noise metrics.

release-bot: starting rollout - sdk/v4.3.0-rc1 to canary (region-us-east-1) build 430-rc. Monitor: telemetry_event_count, telemetry_consent_mismatch, sdk_startup_deprec_logs.

Jordan (Eng): QA plan: new tests to assert SDK doesn't emit telemetry when not opted in, and that the header `X-Redwood-Telemetry-Opt` is set when enabled. I'll add those to the integration suite and link PR.

Priya (Docs): I'll prepare customer-facing wording for CS; keeping it short and practical. Draft excerpt: "We are updating our SDK defaults to require explicit opt-in for telemetry. No action is needed if you do not want to send telemetry. If you rely on automatic telemetry, please enable it explicitly in your SDK configuration or contact support for assistance."

Aisha Khan: Action items summary: 
- Ravi: publish the SDK RC and changelog (owner).
- Priya: push migration banner + FAQ pages (owner).
- Jordan/QA: add integration tests and run sweep against top-20 services.
- CS: send targeted notifications to flagged accounts and offer migration help.

Camille Park: I'll add a short runbook fragment for oncall in case we see sudden drop in telemetry_event_count: check rollout tags, confirm header generation, and contact CS for customer impact.

Ravi Menon: One more snippet for env var opt-in (python):

```py
import os
os.environ['RW_TELEMETRY_ENABLED'] = 'true'
client = RedwoodClient(api_key=os.environ['RW_KEY'])
```

Priya (Docs): All right — I'll post the doc links and the customer note link when live. Please react with :eyes: if you've reviewed the migration guide.

Aisha Khan: Thanks all. Please escalate any blockers in this thread.

Camille Park: :eyes:

Jordan (Eng): :thumbsup:
